title: test(runtime): route-ledger conformance checks that every route the dispatcher plugin mounts has a ledger row
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-project-manager"} -->
_Requested by **Leehom** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1X?thread=cmsg_01TenzsRopZj4jMbvjX8uz1XFTvndcbx3e4rrGbDvfcLXh)_

Fixes #26513

## What changes

`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` gains a per-route arm: **every route `dispatcher-plugin.ts` mounts on its host `IHttpServer` must have a `ROUTE_LEDGER` row.** The mounted side is recorded, never typed: the plugin's own `start()` runs against a recording server (the same technique as `automation-api-contract-mounts.test.ts`), and the recorded `VERB /path` list is the population. No count is written anywhere.

- **Composition.** One start, in the plugin's widest composition, so as few mounts as possible go unobserved: no REST plugin on the kernel (the plugin keeps `/discovery`; it cedes that route when REST is present), a serveable `analytics` service (the capability-conditional `/analytics` routes mount), and `scoping.enableProjectScoping: true` under the default `projectResolution: 'auto'` (every environment-scoped twin mounts beside its unscoped route). The other compositions are strict subsets. A vacuity test asserts the boot actually reached those three branches.
- **Matching.** An exact `VERB /api/v1/pattern` row, or a `* /prefix/**` family row whose base the mount sits at or under. That is the same reading the live-mount parity gate gives a wildcard row. A scoped twin answers to its unscoped row, because the plugin mounts it by calling the same registrar with the scoped base and `dispatch()` strips the scope before routing.
- **Not exercised:** routes a service emits at runtime on the `ai:routes` hook. They are dynamic by construction, and the `* /ai/**` family row speaks for them. The plugin's own `/ai/*` mounts are recorded.
- **Why this enumeration.** It is the cheapest complete one: it needs no booted server and no production listing method, and it observes every registration the plugin makes. The measured mount table is 124 routes. No `@objectstack/runtime` code changes; this PR adds no listing method.
- **#17041 references.** The three dead `#17041` pointers (the `route-ledger.ts` census header, this suite's header, `scripts/check-route-ledger-census.mjs`) are re-pointed to #26513, and each says what the new arm does and does not cover. **#17041's open question is left as it is**: whether the ledger should be checked per route *beyond what the plugin mounts* stays an open maintainer question, now tracked at #26513.
- **`check-route-ledger-census` stays.** Whether it retires is #26431's call, after this lands. It is still the only per-row guard for the rows the arm cannot see (next section).
- The `route-ledger.ts` top header said this suite fails "when an entry claims a client method that does not exist". That direction lives in the client package's guards, so the sentence now says so.

## Why

Deleting a single mid-ledger row left this suite green. Only the hand-kept row count noticed, and that count is the transcription-pin shape #26431 retires.

## What the arm guards, measured

Per-row ablation over the recorded mount table: **71 of 105 rows** now red this suite when deleted. The other 34 cannot, because they have no mount of their own spelling:

- routes only `dispatch()` answers behind a catch-all host (the hono adapter's `app.all(prefix/*)`): every `/meta` and `/data` row, `/share-links`, `/security/suggested-bindings`, `/ui/view`;
- doors a plugin serves from the raw app on a self-hosted kernel: `/approvals/act`, `/webhooks/redeliver`, `/automation/hooks/:flowName/:hookId`;
- the two `servedBy` specializations: `POST /actions/global/:action`, `POST /actions/_activation/:object/:action`;
- family rows (`* /auth/**`, `* /apps/**`, `* /share-links/**`) and `GET /mcp/skill`, which `* /mcp/**` absorbs.

⚠️ **This includes all three rows the card named.** `GET /meta/types` is not mounted by the plugin; on `objectstack serve` REST mounts it, and on a catch-all host `dispatch()` resolves it inside the `/meta` domain's inline if-chain. The two `/actions` rows are `servedBy` specializations that are registered nowhere. So a mount-derived arm cannot red on them. Turning those red would need route-granularity enumeration of `dispatch()` itself, which today exists only as inline `parts[N] === 'literal'` code. The order's red-first used a bridge-mounted row instead (Tests below). The seat has the question of the remaining 34 rows in the report.

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么**：运行时路由台账的一致性测试新增一条按路由的反向检查：分派插件实际挂载的每条路由，都必须在台账里有一行。
- **为什么改**：以前删掉台账中间某一行，这个测试照样全绿，只有手写的行数计数会报错（#26431 要退役的那种）。
- **风险与回滚**：只改测试和注释，不改产品代码，不发布。回滚就是 revert 这个 PR。
- **先看**：`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`（新增的 `dispatcherPluginMounts` 和 `hasLedgerRow`），`packages/runtime/src/route-ledger.ts` 的 CENSUS 注释段。
- **两分钟验证**：从 `route-ledger.ts` 删掉 `GET /automation/actions` 这一行，跑 `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime exec vitest run --project local src/route-ledger.conformance.test.ts`，应看到 1 个失败，并点名 `GET /api/v1/automation/actions`。
- **需要你做的**：无，席位落地。

## Tests

Red first on `main` `16ca320c92` vs this head. Ablation through `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, deleting the row `GET /automation/actions` (mid-ledger, in a domain with siblings). The mutation landed (anchor 1 → 0) and was restored to the HEAD blob with `git diff HEAD` empty both times. The ablation is not committed.

<details><summary>Ablation readings</summary>

- **`main`, row deleted:** `route-ledger.conformance.test.ts` 6/6 passed (exit 0). The old suite cannot see it.
- **This head, row deleted:** 1 failed, 7 passed (exit 1): `Dispatcher mounts with no route-ledger row: GET /api/v1/automation/actions, GET /api/v1/environments/:environmentId/automation/actions.`
- **This head, `GET /meta/types` deleted (the card's example):** 8/8 passed (exit 0), as measured above: that row has no mount to derive from.
- **This head, unmutated:** 8/8 passed.

</details>

Test budget: no server is booted. The arm adds one `createDispatcherPlugin().start()` against a recording server, shared by both tests through `beforeAll`. Suite wall: 15.45 s on `main`, 16.72 s here (shared box; almost all of it is the `import` phase, 15.28 s vs 16.54 s, from loading `dispatcher-plugin.ts`). Test time is 12 ms vs 16 ms.

## Acceptance notes

- The arm guards what the plugin mounts. Rows only `dispatch()` answers stay census-guarded, as listed above.
- No production listing method was added. The order allowed one only if no complete enumeration existed without it, and the recording server is complete for the mount. A listing of `dispatch()`'s inline arms would be a hand-written second ledger, not derived from anything that routes, so it is not offered here.

## Verification

Run on `2eae6bd3`, the final head.

<details><summary>Local runs</summary>

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime test` (under `os-verify-lock`): Test Files 457 passed (457), Tests 7424 passed | 19 skipped. Exit 0.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/runtime typecheck`: exit 0 (`check:test-typecheck: OK`).
- `eslint --no-inline-config` on the three touched files: exit 0, no findings.
- Derived gates (`node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack`): 70 commands, each exit code captured before any pipe. 68 exit 0, including `pnpm check:route-ledger-census` (its `--self-test`, then `reads 105, array holds 105`). 2 exit 3, **NOT MEASURED** (each gate refused its own prerequisite; CI runs both): `node scripts/check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` (the positive control is pinned to a commit this shallow clone cannot reach) and `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` (needs a full `pnpm build`). `--ran`: `✓ 70 derived famil(ies) accounted for — 68 run, 2 NOT-MEASURED`.

</details>

- [x] 3. No formatter ran; `pnpm lint` passes (scoped to the touched files).

- [x] 5. Nothing publishes (test, a runtime-internal module's comment, a repo script), so `skip-changeset`. Both declaration lines are filled in.
- [x] 6. `packages/spec` not touched.
- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English (the 维护者速读 block is the lane's required Chinese summary).
